description: Deploys item definitions from a source directory to a workspace. Returns per-item success/failure results and duration.

data.hint: Do not automatically retry the deployment or its entire batch. Preserve evidence, reconcile existing work read-only and review a new scoped plan before further mutation.

errorDetails.hint: Preserve the exact request and inspect existing work read-only; do not resubmit.

notes: Status values: 'succeeded' (no action failures; recorded nonfatal hooks can still fail), 'partial_failure' (action failures; exit 1), 'no_changes' (everything already in sync). The 'failures' array retains 'change', 'error', and legacy 'code'; typed errors add canonical 'errorDetails'. A legacy strategy override such as BULK_IMPORT_FAILED does not replace errorDetails.code. Every action/recorded-hook failure carries retryAllowed:false and triggers batch no-replay guidance. Post-hooks fire after successful creates/updates (SemanticModel refresh, Environment publish). AUDIT: pass --verify to add a 'verification' block ({converged, checked, discrepancies[], existence_only[]}) that re-fetches the applied items and confirms convergence (content items hash-compared to source, platform-only existence-checked) — report-only, exit code unchanged. Equivalent to re-running 'deploy plan' and expecting all Skip. NOTE the API normalizes hand-authored content (notebooks) on first ingest, so a first deploy may report converged:false; reconcile outcomes and review a new plan using canonical 'deploy export' output to converge. .platform is excluded from the hash, so pure metadata-only changes won't surface as drift.
safety_notes: The main success example includes existing-definition updates. The destructive field describes the selected plan: updates, rename/republication, deletes or force-all are destructive; create-only/no-op plans are not. A destructive dry-run carries agentNotice for detected AI agents and requires approval before execution. retryAllowed:false overrides nested retriable:true and diagnosticHint; do not replay a whole batch. Shared bulk request evidence is not proof every member failed remotely. Missing/duplicate/unknown bulk results become BULK_RESULT_UNVERIFIED, not success. Reconcile read-only before reviewing further mutation; missing structured evidence is not proof of non-submission.
